# Check: upstream stdin-buffer.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/stdin-buffer.test.ts

## Subject
StdinBuffer: accumulates incomplete escape sequences, emits completed sequences and bracketed-paste events.

## Upstream test count (approx)
45

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- passes through regular/multiple/unicode characters immediately
- passes through complete mouse SGR, arrow, function, meta, SS3 sequences
- buffers incomplete mouse SGR and CSI; split across many chunks
- flushes incomplete sequence after timeout
- chars followed by escape sequence; escape followed by chars
- multiple complete sequences; partial sequence with preceding chars
- Kitty CSI-u press and release events; batched press+release; multiple batched; arrows and functional keys with event type
- plain characters mixed with Kitty sequences (before and after); rapid typing simulation
- mouse press/release/move; split mouse; multiple mouse events
- old-style mouse sequence (ESC[M + 3 bytes); buffers incomplete old-style mouse
- empty input
- lone escape character with timeout and explicit flush
- Buffer.from input handled
- very long sequences
- flushes incomplete sequences; empty array if nothing to flush; emits flushed data via timeout
- clears buffered content without emitting
- emits 'paste' event for complete bracketed paste; handles paste in chunks, paste with surrounding input, paste with newlines, paste with unicode
- clears buffer on destroy; clears pending timeouts on destroy

## Upstream dependencies
StdinBuffer from ../src/stdin-buffer.js

## Upstream notes
StdinBuffer({timeout}) ms. Emits 'data' per complete sequence; 'paste' for bracketed paste (ESC[200~ ... ESC[201~). Methods: getBuffer(), flush(), clear(), destroy(). Based on OpenTUI (MIT).

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/stdin_fsm_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.
